sum3:
def main(a, b, c):
    return a + b + c
pair-sum:
def main(a, b):
    return (b, a + b)
select:
def main(a, b, flag):
    return a if flag else b
and:
def main(p, q):
    return p and q
xor:
def main(p, q):
    return p != q
majority:
def main(p, q, r):
    return sum([p, q, r]) >= 2
count-true:
def main(p, q, r):
    return sum([p, q, r])
max:
def main(a, b):
    return a if a > b else b
min3:
def main(a, b, c):
    return a if a <= b and a <= c else (b if b <= c else c)
abs-diff:
def main(a, b):
    return abs(a - b)
clamp:
def main(x, lo, hi):
    return lo if x < lo else (hi if x > hi else x)
